blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Sunday challenged Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano to name those people he allegedly threatened in relation to reported anomalous infrastructure projects and illegal reclamation in Taguig City. Lacson’s remarks were in response to Cayetano’s Facebook Live post where the latter had claimed receiving “feelers” that some parties were being pressured to admit there were irregularities in Taguig. “Senator Cayetano should name the ‘individuals’ he alleged I threatened, so I can properly address this new issue point by point,” Lacson said in a statement. “Spinning tales betrays panic but like guilt, it will never […]...
